messages:
jordan: Heads-up — PR #18654 touches request-routing, eviction heuristics, and a tiny KMS config change. Need cross-team eyes before we cut the release tomorrow morning. @sam (runtime), @mia (infra), @ashley (security) — can you take a look? This blocks canary.
katie: tagging infra/runtime/security owners — roughly how long for review? can we get approvals by EOD? :eyes:
sam: I can do a pass in ~2 hours. Quick question: does this change any KV cache layout or only eviction thresholds? If it's just thresholds should be quick.
jordan: only thresholds + one fallback route. no KV layout changes. the eviction policy now adds an early-evict path for >512-token sequences when GPU mem pressure > 85%.
mia: ok I can validate autoscaler interactions but need perf numbers / trace to ensure we won't thrash. can you paste the perf run you mentioned in the PR?
jordan: pasted below — this was a short local run (not prod):
```
# local perf run (k80 sim)
requests: 2000
p50 latency: 62ms
p95 latency: 210ms
eviction hits (early): 128
GPU mem peak: 78%
```
Note: prod traces look similar but I'll attach full traces to the PR after CI finishes.
ashley: security quick-check: the KMS tweak sets a new envelope key path. Need a short threat note + confirmation that key rotation semantics unchanged. Also ensure we don't log key identifiers.
jordan: ack. I'll add a 2-line threat note and remove the `key_id` from debug logs. also adding unit test to verify no plaintext key material is emitted.
ci-bot: CI: tests/eviction_test.py ✓  build: linux-x64 ✓  integration: flaky (1 failure) — rerun with `ci retry 18654`
sam: ran a quick static pass — two comments left inline: one about a variable name and one about a potential NPE when `cache.get()` returns null. should be a 10m fix.
katie: if sam's fixes are small I'll do the merge once infra + security ack. can we add a short rollback plan in the PR description? e.g., revert to prior thresholds + force-canary to 0.
jordan: good idea, added rollback steps to PR description and a canary schedule: 10% for 30m -> 50% for 1h -> full. @ben can you book the canary window in the release calendar?
ben: booked the 3am UTC slot and linked it in the PR. I'll own the rollback play if needed.
mia: one infra request — include a script to repro the mem-pressure locally (small script below). helps validate on-prem setups.
```
# repro-mem-pressure.sh (very rough)
python tools/send_requests.py --seq-len 600 --concurrency 8 --duration 300
```
jordan: added that script and pushed a tiny fix for the NPE. CI rerun started.
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅  integration: flaky tests cleared
ashley: looked at the threat note — LGTM, just one nit: change wording "no key ids logged" -> "no key identifiers or material logged". otherwise approve from sec side.
mia: infra OK from my side after the repro and perf sanity. approved.
sam: runtime approved after the minor rename and NPE guard.
katie: platform ack, I'll merge once the branch protection timer finishes. leaving a post-merge checklist in the PR for observability alerts and rollout knobs.
jordan: thanks everyone. ping me if the canary shows anomalies, I'll be on-call during the rollout. :thumbsup:
